name: National Autistic Society
description: A UK autism charity providing information, campaigning, education and support services, local branches, an online community and directories of services.
intended_use: Find autism information, community routes, services and organisations in the UK.
audience_or_context: Autistic people, families, carers, professionals and others looking for UK-focused autism information or support routes.
limitations: Services and local availability vary by area and may have separate eligibility or cost requirements.
The organisation's policy positions and service descriptions are its own and are not treated as neutral evidence merely because the organisation is established.
cost_or_access_notes: Information on the website is broadly accessible; individual services, training, membership or events may have eligibility requirements or costs.
conflicts_of_interest: The charity provides and promotes some of the services and programmes it describes and also fundraises for its work.

provenance.method: Official organisation surface and current service routes checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records identity, scope and access without treating organisational authority as evidence for unrelated claims.
